body:
I had the most amazing experience on this drug. In retrospect, I would do this over and over again. I can see why it is said to be highly addictive, feeling the need to redose constantly as my friends all tried more and more of the chemical. Insufflating it presents very uplifting, energetic, and 'in the zone' type feelings within minutes of doing it. It is way more effective and cost efficient than doing cocaine or any prescription meds such as vyvanse or adderall.
I came about it through a relative who said they could get me some via the internet and sent it to me. I tried it once when I received the chemical in the mail but probably not enough considering I do not have a scale that would accurately measure out approximately 7 mg which I heard was the accurate dose. I started my night off with a Sierra Nevada on draft and then went home and tried the MDPV with my girlfriend. We insufflated about half of a dose (4 mg) just to see what it would do, and we were in heaven immediately. I wanted to do more after only 30 min whenever we went to a friend's house to drink some and let my friend try some MDPV with us. I felt entirely good all over and ready to fuckin party hard after we insufflated about 5 mg more each. My friend immediately felt the upper effects that I had previously described to him and we were ready to start our night. This was at 1045 approximately. It is now 6 am as I write this ridiculous report just because I want the world to experience what I am experiencing at the moment, its awesome potential and potency. Be careful.
I redosed at approximately 12 am 1245 am and again at 2 am.
I feel geeked as hell. Alright I've been staring at this screen typing this stuff for over 15 minutes now and I don't know where time is going. I have to work a double tomorrow as a server at a seafood restaurant and I am going to hate life. At least I have some more MDPV I can do when I wake up to start my day off right!
MDPV is one hell of a drug.
